evals.prompt: Test the support agent with prompt draft pv_42 and draft version rv_17 of its already published and assigned refund Rulebook before either draft is published.
evals.expected_output: Runs one controlled Generate Answer turn with the exact eligible artifact IDs, records the complete override set, and makes clear that active configuration is unchanged.
assertions: Resolves the target agent and both exact artifact IDs
Sends promptVersionId and ruleVersionIds through artifacts
Verifies that rv_17 belongs to a rule already published and assigned to the target bot
Does not publish either draft
Records the artifact set with the actual answer and event IDs
Checks for configured Attribute and reachable Action effects

evals.prompt: Replay yesterday's failed refund conversation and score the same regression across our last 100 support conversations.
evals.expected_output: Routes historical-turn regeneration to Replay and the persistent cohort regression to a Test Suite run with saved context and mocks rather than using Generate Answer for both.
assertions: Does not create a new Generate Answer conversation as a substitute for Replay
Routes the historical turn to the replay workflow
Routes the multi-case criteria run to the Test Suite workflow
States that Test Suite supports published/draft configuration and simulated Actions without live fallback
Explains that Generate Answer is appropriate only for a one-turn runtime proof

evals.prompt: Send 'cancel my subscription' to our production agent as a harmless read-only bot test.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that the normal user-turn runtime may invoke a cancellation Action and does not misclassify the test as read-only.
assertions: Inspects the responding agent's published Rulebooks for Action Tool nodes
States that an Action can call and mutate an external customer system
Uses a controlled test account or obtains clarity on acceptable effects before sending
Does not rely on Action assignment junctions as a runtime gate
Records any observed external effect

evals.prompt: Continue email conversation int_123 and personalize the answer with plan=enterprise. The agent also has a Get Account attribute.
evals.expected_output: Continues the exact conversation, sends email through the dedicated channel field, distinguishes caller user attributes from the configured Attribute lookup, and interprets the created events in context.
assertions: Uses interactionId rather than starting a new conversation
Uses email through direct REST metadata.channel or the MCP channel input and does not place channel in metadata.user_attributes
Sends plan through metadata.user_attributes without inventing other fields
Treats Get Account as a configured Attribute that can run automatically only when this agent and channel are eligible
Does not conflate supplied metadata with Attribute output
Fetches the full conversation when persisted context evidence is needed

evals.prompt: Upload this screenshot to Generate Answer and ask the bot what is wrong.
evals.expected_output: Explains that the public Generate Answer request does not accept file attachments and does not fabricate an upload workflow.
assertions: Does not claim inbound attachment support
Does not confuse response attachment metadata with request attachment input
Offers only a currently documented text or artifact-based alternative
